label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Routes along tracks also walk along roads: the map's primary and secondary roads (not motorways, rail or raceways) join the track network, each metre counted 1.25 times a metre of track, so tracks are preferred where both go. A tap close to a road is followed too.

Fords within reason: one straight crossing of a mapped river or stream (map river lines and wide-river areas; not lakes), at most 120 m wide, counted 3 times its width plus 150 m, so a bridge or a track round is taken unless the ford saves a real detour. Never a straight jump without a river in between.

tests.kotlinJvm: all pass, full suite (new: road between tracks, track preferred to a parallel road, ford vs far bridge, nearby bridge vs ford, no ford without a river or when too wide)
